prompt: Use implementation-planning to produce the security-sensitive design and TDD plan for DOC-27 from the attached repository evidence. Do not change code.
expected_output: A least-privilege plan that requires documents:read, scopes lookup atomically by trusted tenant and document ID, and keeps credential resolution in composition behind a read-only content port.
expectations: Replace administrator authorization with the exact permission.
Make tenant scope mandatory in the repository lookup.
Inject a read-only content reader without passing credentials or environment through application code.
Test denied, allowed, foreign-tenant, absent, and sanitized-failure paths.
critical_forbidden_outcomes: Retaining administrator authorization or trusting request-supplied tenant data.
Fetching globally and filtering after retrieval.
Passing credential strings, environment objects, or secret providers through application interfaces.
Logging credential material or document content.
Claiming ready without admitted commands, security review, and same-revision reviews.
